list: The official 55 trophies as published by PlayStation (Exophase and PSNProfiles, 2026-11-18). Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones; every guide is written in our own words from those official descriptions.
sourceNote: Trophy names, descriptions and grades come from the official list mirrored by Exophase (exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies) and PSNProfiles (psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi). The game launched on 19 November 2026, so exact locations and steps are not yet verified in-game; guides flag where they are reasoning from the description rather than confirmed play.

trophies.guide: There is nothing to do for this one on its own: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Follow the five roadmap stages in order — story, side missions, activities, collectibles, then money and cleanup — and use the Next Up tab to see what is still missing.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end and the trophy pops. It is the first mission of the game, so it comes early and cannot be missed if you finish the mission. Mission replay has not been confirmed for this game yet, so finish it properly on your first attempt.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Work through the story missions of Chapter 1 in order; the trophy unlocks when the chapter's last mission is complete. Chapters cannot be skipped, so this one is safe as long as you keep playing the story.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. The trophy pops at the end of the chapter's final mission — there is nothing extra to collect or do, just keep following the story.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Play Chapter 3 through to its final mission. As with the other chapter trophies, finishing the chapter is the whole requirement — no side content is needed for this one.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and it pops when the chapter's final mission ends. After this, only the final mission stands between you and the story's gold trophy.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Finish the campaign's final mission — this is the story's gold trophy. Before you start the finale, clear anything one-time you still want from earlier chapters: partner moments, choice trophies and mission-specific trophies, because the story may not let you go back freely afterwards.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It pops when the mission ends. Whether missions can be replayed is not yet confirmed, so treat it as one-time and finish it properly on your first attempt rather than rushing past objectives.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Expect a multi-stage job — follow the mission markers and finish every stage. Do it on your first run in case missions cannot be replayed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. The trophy pops when the mission is finished. Like the other named-mission trophies, do it on your first attempt — mission replay is unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners and the trophy pops. Finish the mission on your first run, since replay is unconfirmed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, the takedown at Vice City International Airport. Finish the mission and the trophy pops. Do it on your first run in case missions cannot be replayed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the mission and the trophy pops. Do it on your first run, since mission replay is unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's completion counter — that means the story, side missions, activities and collectibles, effectively everything else on this list. Save this for last: it is the second gold trophy and it pops once the counter hits 100%. Check the in-game stats page to see which categories are still short.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts anywhere in Leonida — jumps, near misses, long airtime and drifts all count. This is a grind, not a one-time feat: work on it naturally as you drive around, and mop up the remainder late in the game by chaining jumps off ramps and hills. It can be done entirely in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type in the game at least once. The official description does not list them, but the game's activities include the ones on this list — races, fishing, arcade games, the shooting range, drone races, bowling, meditation and stunts. Work through the activity trophies one by one and this pops when you have tried them all. The in-game activities menu shows what is available if a type is unclear.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — PlayStation tracks 42 of them. Visit the shooting range, work through each challenge and beat its gold-medal target score or time. This is a skill trophy: take it weapon by weapon, learn each challenge's layout, and retry the ones you miss — challenges can be retried as often as you like.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN count: 42 Shooting Range challenges)

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its locations around Leonida. Find the drone race spots, enter each one and finish first. Learn the course on a practice run, then race to win — the trophy pops when you have a win at every location, not just one.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 20 distinct race events, not the same one 20 times. Work through the race locations across Leonida in different vehicles and race types. Each win counts once per event, so keep moving to new races rather than repeating one.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and beat him. Find the fishing spots around Leonida, enter a challenge against Cal and out-fish him. Fishing challenges reward patience and the right spot — if you lose, challenge him again until you win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Play an arcade game to completion at an arcade in Leonida. Find an arcade machine, start a game and finish it — any arcade game counts. This is a quick one to tick off early whenever you pass an arcade.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand — play through all of Andy's missions until the final one is complete. Side-mission strands usually unlock as the story progresses, so check back with Andy between story chapters. Do the final mission when it appears; whether side missions can be replayed is unconfirmed, so finish it properly the first time.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand — play through all of Kenton's missions until the final one is complete. Check back with Kenton as the story advances. Finish the final mission on your first attempt, since side-mission replay is unconfirmed.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand — play through all of Billy's missions until the final one is complete. Check back with Billy between story chapters and finish the final mission when it unlocks. Do it on your first attempt, since side-mission replay is unconfirmed.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — the Strangers & Freaks style side missions. Watch for stranger markers on the map as you explore, play each strand to its end, and keep count: eight completed strands earns the silver. Strands unlock across the story, so revisit new areas as they open up.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand — play through all of Randy's missions until the final one is complete. Check back with Randy as the story advances and finish the final mission on your first attempt, since side-mission replay is unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand — play through all of Tyrone's missions until the final one is complete. Check back with Tyrone between story chapters and finish the final mission on your first attempt, since side-mission replay is unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find every meditation spot in Leonida and meditate at each one. Meditation spots are scattered across the state — explore the map thoroughly, including quiet and scenic places. The trophy pops when you have meditated at the last spot; use the map to keep track of where you have already been.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — find the animal Bret asks about and take it down. This is a hunting side task: follow Bret's strand, locate the animal in its habitat and make the kill. If you fail the hunt, try again — the animal should be findable again.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Collect enough cards to complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — search thoroughly, check every area, and keep count per set. This is a collectible grind: work on it alongside exploration and mop up the last sets after the story.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK spots are spread all over the map — visit each one and use it. Keep count and work through the map region by region so you do not miss any; the trophy pops at the 100th distinct location.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind — the game's challenge list covers driving, combat, exploration and more. Work through the challenges menu and tick them off as you play; 50 is a solid chunk but comes naturally if you chase the other trophies, since many of them complete challenges along the way.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. This is a partner moment: do it during a story segment or free-roam session where your partner is with you, raise the heat to 4 stars, then break line of sight and hide until the wanted level clears. It may only be possible while your partner is present, so grab the chance when it comes — flagging this one missable.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the trick is to keep the heat on the whole time. Plan a route past three shops, hit them one after another with your partner, and do not let the cops lose you between robberies. This needs your partner present, so do it when the chance comes — flagging this one missable.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida — drive, ride or find them and they count. Explore the map, try every vehicle type you come across, and keep an eye on the vehicle count in the stats. This is a pure exploration trophy: work on it while doing everything else and mop up rare vehicles late in the game.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: During one use of Combat Focus, take down 5 enemies. Find a spot with a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus and chain the takedowns before it runs out. Pick a fight with enough enemies clustered together — a gang hideout or a heavy police response works — and aim for quick, clean kills.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — get a plane off the ground at VCIA outside of a scheduled flight. Steal a plane from the airport and take off. Expect airport security and police attention, so be quick: get in, start up and leave before the heat stops you. This reads like a one-time story moment, so flagging it as possibly tied to a mission.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank — the description says it all. Find a Rhino, climb in and enjoy it. Military vehicles usually show up at high wanted levels or around military areas; once you are in one, the trophy should pop.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth job. Plan the approach, avoid cameras and guards, get in and out clean. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so take it slow and quiet; you can retry, but a clean first run is the goal.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Find the banks, crack their vaults and get away clean — five times. This is the bigger sibling of the armored truck trophy: plan each robbery, escape the heat after each one, and keep count until the fifth.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find a truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and get away before the police close in. Trucks roam the map, so this can be done in free roam whenever you spot one.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Explore the whole of Leonida — every region of the map. Drive, fly and walk into every corner until the map is fully revealed. This pairs naturally with the collectible and vehicle trophies: explore thoroughly and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida — one per gang. Find each gang's operations, hit them and get away. You need to cover every gang, so keep a list of which gangs you have done and which are left.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view. This is a relaxing one: find the bar or spot on Ocean Beach with the view, sit down with a drink and the trophy pops. Do it whenever you are passing through Vice City.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom — drive a car straight through the showroom glass, classic GTA style. Find a vehicle showroom, get in a car inside it and floor it through the front. This looks like a story-moment trophy, so if it pops during a mission, do it when the moment comes rather than counting on free roam.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl — follow through on a game there. Find the alley, start a game of bowling and play it through. A quick activity trophy to tick off whenever you are nearby.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal — the description is vague, so this is likely tied to growing your partnership's following or reputation in the game. Work on partnership activities and social-facing goals as they appear; check the in-game stats for a partnership or follower count and push it up. Marked as unconfirmed: the exact trigger is not yet known from the official description alone.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Make a story choice — the trophy pops when a decision with consequences is made. Story choices are one-time by nature: once you pick, you cannot unpick it. Think before you choose, and be aware that different choices may gate different outcomes; if you want a specific result, save before the choice if the game allows it. Flagging this one missable.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Do something a second time and get it right — the description suggests retrying something that failed the first time. The exact trigger is not yet known from the official description alone; it may be tied to replaying a mission or redoing a failed attempt. Keep playing and watch for it after a retry; marked as unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Something strange happens — this reads like a secret or easter-egg trophy for stumbling into an odd event in Leonida. The exact trigger is not yet known from the official description alone. Explore, poke at strange places and events, and it should pop when you find it; marked as unconfirmed.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock enemies over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Get a vehicle moving past a group of enemies, lean out and swing. A fast car and a crowded street make this much easier; aim for a clean hit at speed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — take them to your contacts to clean them, and keep doing it until $250,000 has been laundered. This is a money grind that builds up naturally if you keep robbing and laundering; it pairs with the bank vault and armored truck trophies.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across the shops of Leonida — clothes, weapons, vehicles, food, anything sold in a shop counts toward the total. Just keep shopping as you play and the total climbs; late in the game, buy big-ticket items to finish it off. Check the stats to see how much you have spent so far.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida. Garages cost money, so save up — this pairs with the spending and laundering trophies. Visit each property, buy it, and keep going until every garage is yours.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, register each one through the app, and repeat until ten are registered. Any vehicles count, so grab the easy ones first and keep an eye on the count.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
